title: AntibiogramJ Web
description:
Web application for the analysis of disk-diffusion antibiogram images: detection of the Petri dish and the antibiotic disks, OCR of the disk codes, measurement of inhibition zones, S/I/R categorisation with EUCAST/CLSI breakpoints, EUCAST expert rules and quality control. It runs entirely in the web browser (OpenCV.js and ONNX Runtime Web; images never leave the computer) or as a multi-user server (FastAPI). Web successor of the AntibiogramJ desktop application (University of La Rioja).

Live version: https://joheras.github.io/antibiogramj-web/
